aa12_marketing_failure: Official "AA-12 Marketing Failure" (2024-12-22): **Skier sells the AA-12 Gen1 and 12/70 RIP ammo at LL1** and barters for a Lab keycard with **4x AI-2 medkits**.
afterparty: Official "Afterparty" (2023-12-08): **every Boss except Cultists spawns at 100% on its own home map** (Knight / Big Pipe / Birdeye on Lighthouse, Kolontay on Streets of Tarkov).
airdrop_traffic: Official pre-wipe **Day 1 "Airdrop Traffic"** of June 2022 (2022-06-20): **airdrop frequency on outdoor maps is about x6** (Factory/The Lab/Labyrinth excluded).
airdrops_2026: Official "Airdrops" (2026-03-19): **every map except Ground Zero, Factory, The Lab and Labyrinth has an airdrop in every raid**; **medical airdrop crates are stuffed with Vaseline, RShG-2 72.5mm rocket launchers and toilet paper** (added on top of the official random 25~45 items per crate).
all_bosses_reserve: Corresponds to an official pre-wipe event from 2021: **five Bosses - Killa / Tagilla / Sanitar / Kojaniy / Bully - are added to Reserve at 100%** (Reserve normally has only Glukhar); spawn points reuse the map's own data.
all_bosses_shoreline: * Unofficial, author's-choice entry (there is no official "all Bosses on Shoreline" event). All Bosses (with their guards) gather at the Shoreline resort: Glukhar / Killa / Tagilla / Sanitar / Shturman / Reshala / Knight / Kaban / Kolontay - and they no longer appear on their home maps.
ammo_shortage: Official "Ammo Shortage" (2023-11-25): **31 types of high-penetration ammo are removed from traders**; **ammo cannot be traded on the flea market at all**; the event quest "The Punisher - Harvest" is unlocked.
april_fools: SPT's hardcoded April Fools branch (4/1, unlike any official 4/1 event): **Santa Claus on 10 maps** (The Lab 75%) + **22 bots in Santa hats** + Bitcoin renamed (English only) + **forced winter** + summons at 100% (7 maps) + Tagilla in The Lab + 40% Cultist squads on 3 maps + pumpkins + Halloween gear. Note event gear replaces Boss masks/hats (official behavior); config can keep originals.
art_of_explosion: Official "Art of Explosion" (2025-04-29): **7 event quests** (6 in a series + the same-named The Art of Explosion) appear or hide as the event opens and closes.
bad_feeling: Official "Bad Feeling" (2024-07-26): **free entry to The Lab**.
bandages_event: Official "Bandages Event" (2023-04-07): during the event the quest "**Important Patient**" is opened to all players (hand in sterile bandages + army bandages).
barter_only: Official pre-wipe Day 4 of June 2022, "Barter Only" (2022-06-23): **all cash offers are removed from traders** (except Fence) - barter only; traders also have 14 native dogtag barters available.
beer_upgrades: Official "Beer Upgrades Event" (2022-12-18): **hideout upgrades use "Pevko light beer"** (Lavatory levels 2/3); **all hideout build times drop to zero** at the same time.
bloodhounds: Official "Bloodhounds Reveal" (2023-06-09): **the new faction "Bloodhounds" appears at 100% on Customs, Woods and Shoreline**; the same-named event quest "Bloodhounds" is unlocked (the fighters you have to kill are these ones).
bonus_exp_weekend: Official "Bonus EXP weekend" (several runs in 2026: 5-29 / 6-12 / 7-24): **EXP earned in raids +25%** (a flat value, replacing the version bonus).
boosted_skill: Official "skill boost" event of 2022-12-17: **character skill leveling speed is greatly increased (x3)**.
boss_cultist_presence: Two official runs, 2023-12-20 and 2024-04-26: **every Boss spawns at 100% only on its own home map** (Knight / Big Pipe / Birdeye on Lighthouse, etc.); **Tagilla accompanies Killa**; **Cultists at 100%** (Woods, Shoreline).
bosses_home_generic: The official "every Boss spawns at 100% on its own home map" mechanic **has been run 5 times** (2024-08-14 / 2024-11-29 / 2025-07-05 / 2025-11-13 / 2026-07-29), so this entry has no fixed date window and serves as a "generic" small event in the rotation pool.
bosses_rogues_wander: Official "Bosses & Rogues Wander" (2023-07-03): (1) Knight / Big Pipe / Birdeye **spawn in every daytime Factory raid**; (2) the official **Boss timetable** rotates Boss maps by real time (MSK) - 8-12 Reserve / 13-17 Customs / 17-21 Shoreline / 22-2 Interchange / 2-8 Woods (no Boss windows during 12-13 and 21-22).
bosses_take_a_hint: Official "Bosses, take a Hint!" (2023-06-02): unlocks the event quest "Hint"; **every Boss spawns at 100% only on its own home map** (Knight / Big Pipe / Birdeye on Lighthouse, etc.), and **Cultists at 100% on Woods**.
brothers_reunited: Official "Brothers Reunited" (2024-04-17): **in every Interchange raid Tagilla stays right by Killa's side** (the official text places them next to the Kiba weapon store).
casus_belli: Official "Casus Belli" (2026-04-09 to 04-20): arena gladiators (Rogues) escape the arena and rob everyone they see across all five raids; Ref and Skier each open a quest line for 7 quests in total, two of which are mutually exclusive "pick a side" quests. 7 event quests are unlocked.
centralized_loot: Official "Centralized Loot" (2022-12-24): **each map's loot is concentrated into 1 spot** - Customs=Skull, Factory=underground, Interchange=Kiba escalator, Reserve=near the helicopter, Shoreline=Administration building, Lighthouse=water treatment plant, Woods=USEC/medical camp, The Lab=conference room (cat room). Actual effect: **map-wide loot chance x1.5**, not moving loot to one spot.
christmas: SPT's native Christmas window (from 12/13): **dancing trees on 7 maps**, **Santa Claus on 10 maps** (50% on each map except The Lab/Labyrinth), **Christmas gear for 22 characters**. Note Boss festive gear pushes the signature mask's hit chance down to ~0.07% (official behavior); enable the matching option in the config to keep Bosses in original gear.
christmas_january: Official Christmas January window (1/2-1/14): **Santa Claus** and the **hideout Christmas tree** continue, **without the khorovod**. This is the third Christmas window alongside 12/13-12/31 and 1/1.
closed_flea: Flea market closed (level requirement raised to 99, so nothing can be bought).
cultist_hunting: Official "Cultist Hunting" (2023-06-26): **Cultists appear in every raid on Night Factory, Customs, Woods and Shoreline**, and the event quest "Failed Setup" is unlocked. This event **forces night raids**.
cultist_pilgrimage: Official "Cultist Pilgrimage" (2024-12-18): Cultists spawn in every raid on Customs/Woods/Shoreline; Mechanic sells night vision devices at a deep discount; **Mechanic buys cultist knives and trades out colored Lab keycards** (blue/yellow 1 each, green/red 3 each, purple/black 2 each - 6 colors in total).
dogtag_sales: Official "Dogtag Sales Event" (2022-12-19): **dogtag sell price rises to 2,646 roubles per level** (base price 900, about x2.94).
dogtags_fire_sale: Official "Dogtags Fire Sale" (2023-12-24): **traders trade dogtags for high-end armor, helmets, weapons and ammo** - Ragman offers plates/Altyn/5.11 Hexgrid vests, Mechanic offers advanced ammo, Prapor offers the HK416A5/SR-25/AXMC; **both BEAR and USEC dogtags are accepted**.
factory_cleanup_crew: Official "Arena Cleanup Crew on Factory" (2026-05-01): **daytime Factory spawns Tagilla and Killa in every raid**; **the "Cleanup Crew" in groups of 3~4 replaces regular SCAVs each raid** (better ammo and plates); **Factory cannot be entered in SCAV mode**; **transitions into Factory are disabled**.
flea_promotion: Official flea market promotion (2022-12-23 / 2023-12-22): **listing fees are completely waived**; **the flea market is accessible at any level**.
free_lab_access: The Lab and Labyrinth can be entered without a keycard (this is the official 2024 free Lab access event).
full_speed_ahead: Official #11 Full Speed Ahead (2026-05-15): **Rogues (ex-USEC)** move to Shoreline/Reserve and to new spawn points on Lighthouse; Glukhar spawns in every Reserve raid; **Knight / Big Pipe / Birdeye spawn only on Shoreline** in every raid and no longer appear on other maps.
geared_scavs: Official "Geared Scavs" (2024-12-21): **player SCAV starting gear is improved across the board** (14 karma tiers x 6 slots); **enemy SCAVs are unaffected**.
green_flare: Official green flare event (2022-12-25): **acid-green signal flares return** - firing one **turns nearby SCAVs and Bosses friendly** (vanilla mechanic, effective within 200m). This event also adds **radar-tech airdrops** (radar station spare parts x2~4, which can hold the mortar event's quest items).
halloween: SPT's native Halloween (seasonal window 10/28-11/9): **Tagilla carries a scythe**, Halloween lighting in the hideout, **ghoulish trader portraits**, free entry to The Lab and Labyrinth, pumpkin candy jars, pumpkins in SCAV backpacks, Halloween gear (pumpkin helmet + ghost mask) and stim buffs. **No zombie mode**.
halloween_2022: Official Halloween 2022 (from 10/27): **Tagilla on every map** (HP x1.5, scythe, skull mask) + **Cultists on every map except The Lab** + **official Halloween gear** + **ghoulish trader portraits** + **a random pure-debuff status at raid start** (bleeding / concussion+fracture / concussion+fracture+pain / frostbite) + **guns jam more often** + **some supplies no longer restore hydration/energy**.
halloween_2023: Official "Halloween 2023 Part 1 & 2" (10-26 / 10-30): Part 1 = **Tagilla carries a scythe** + pumpkins + hideout decorations; Part 2 = **Cultist rituals on 7 maps (Zryachiy chain)** + **forced night raids** + **only 1 extraction point left after the ritual** + cursed tags + vengeance reindeer outfit + trader portraits.
hardcore_mode: Official "Hardcore Mode" (2023-07-07): unlocks the event quest "Cocktail Tasting"; **the Obdolbos cocktail stim is heavily reworked** - **Endurance +50 / Strength +50 for 1800 seconds**.
heatwave: Official "Heatwave" (2021-07-29): **thirst drain in raid is doubled**; **the 4 water collector recipes in the hideout take x2 as long**.
hustle: Official "Hustle" (2024-05-31): **Reserve spawns all Bosses and the Goons in every raid** (reusing the map's own spawn points; regular spawn points may still show up), **Bosses carry GP coins in their pockets**, **player SCAV cooldown is shortened**; 2 event quests are unlocked (including "Hustle").
instant_hideout_build: Official "Instant Hideout Building" (2023-08-06 and two other runs): **hideout module and upgrade build times drop to zero**. It also comes with the official **Beer Upgrades**: **crafting Pevko light beer takes 30 hours and yields only 1 bottle each time**.
june2022_free_labs: The Lab and Labyrinth can be entered without a keycard (pre-wipe Day 5 version).
june2022_toxin: Official pre-wipe **Day 7 "Deadly Toxin"**, June 2022 (2022-06-26), **only on Customs**: **every extraction point but 1 is locked**; you get "Unknown Toxin" on entry and **must find the xTG-12 antidote within 8 minutes** or die - it appears in airdrops, SCAV pockets and Bosses; injecting clears the toxin and resets the timer. You also get superhuman buffs (healing/energy/vitality, no downsides).
june2022_unlocked: All traders' loyalty levels are unlocked to the maximum (pre-wipe Day 6 version).
key_to_salvation: Official "A Key to Salvation" (2024-06-24): unlocks the quest "A Key to Salvation"; **Mechanic (LL1) adds 6 "colored keycards <- Military battery" barters** (blue/green=1 / yellow/purple=2 / red/black=3); **Raiders guard the battery spawn points**.
khorovod_2024: Official 2024 Christmas "Khorovod" (2024-12-26 to 2025-01-15): **10 event quests**, **khorovod circles on six maps**, **frostbite**, winter weather, **Santa Claus (50% on 10 maps)**, a Christmas tree in the hideout, and a gift list of 1898 items.
laboratory_breach: Official "Laboratory Breach" (2023-12-21): **free entry to The Lab** (no keycard needed).
labs_free_generic: The official "free entry to The Lab" mechanic **has been run repeatedly over the years** (2022-12-26 / 2023-07-24 / 2023-12-21 / 2024-05-12 / 2024-07-26 / 2025-10-08, etc.), so this entry **has no fixed date window** and serves as a "generic" small event in the rotation pool; use the dated entry for a specific run.
lighthouse_airdrops: Official "Lighthouse Airdrops" (2026-09-26): **airdrop frequency above Lighthouse is greatly increased (x4) and the contents are high-value** - Lighthouse only.
marathon: Official "Marathon" (2024-08-20): **all map transitions are opened**, so you can chain-travel between multiple maps (Ground Zero -> Streets of Tarkov <-> The Lab -> Interchange -> Customs -> Factory -> Woods -> Reserve -> Lighthouse -> Shoreline). Note this event opens **every transition point**, not the single fixed route of the official event.
meeting_of_the_bosses: Official "Meeting of the Bosses" (2022-06-22, the "Eight Shadows" summit): **all 8 Bosses in the game gather on Customs** - Reshala / Glukhar / Killa / Shturman / Sanitar / Tagilla / Zryachiy / Cultist Priest; their home-map spawns are removed at the same time.
meeting_of_the_bosses_2026: Reserve spawns all 8 Scav Bosses at the same time (Meeting of the Bosses).
melee_event: Official "Melee Event" (2022-12-20): **melee weapon damage is increased by 50%~80%** (this event uses the midpoint, x1.65).
mortar_strike: Official "Mortar Strike" (2024-09-26): **Customs/Woods/Shoreline/Reserve are shelled by mortars**, and when the second salvo starts a **special airdrop crate drops (radar station spare parts x2~4, which can hold quest items)**; the "The Eye" mortar marker is introduced; 3 event quests are unlocked; this event also gives **loot x1.25**.
newyear: SPT's native New Year window (1/1): **Santa Claus** (50% on each map except The Lab/Labyrinth) and the same content as Christmas; the official game never made "New Year" a separate event, so New Year content continues the Christmas event.
night_of_the_cult: Official 2024 Halloween cult ritual phase (10/11-10/24, aka The Cultist Event): Customs / Woods / Shoreline each spawn a Cultist squad at 40% (leader "Harbinger", ex-USEC followers, two Cultist guards), mostly at night. Unlocks quest "Night of the Cult". **The official loot bonus is only for cultist rooms (room-level); this mod approximates "the 7 maps above x1.25 overall"** - wider but milder.
obdolbos_roulette: Official pre-wipe Day 2 of June 2022, "Obdolbos Roulette" (2022-06-21): **the Obdolbos cocktail stim gets a huge buff**. Note that stim has a built-in "chance of instant death", which this event does not change.
permanent_boss_presence: Official "Permanent Boss Presence" series: **every Boss spawns at 100% on its own home map** (Cultists and Partisan excluded). This event: Boss weapons are swapped to high-capacity drum magazines (14 Bosses + regular SCAVs); **Mechanic (LL4) adds 11 "Dogtags -> Boss unique gear" barters**.
ram_shortage: Official "RAM Shortage" (2025-12-15): **RAM prices x1.5**; **Mechanic adds 3 RAM barters** (for printed circuit boards / power cords / wires); **RAM can be found in the pockets/backpacks of 14 Bosses and 3 SCAV types**.
reshala_vs_glukhar: Official "Reshala vs Glukhar" (2026-05-08): **Reshala and Glukhar spawn in every raid on Customs** (Glukhar moved over from Reserve); their **followers roam the whole map and fight each other**; **no regular SCAVs spawn on Customs at all**, and player SCAVs are limited to 3 per raid.
resurging_conflict: Official "Resurging Conflict" (2024-12-19): **Prapor and Peacekeeper trade the opposing faction's dogtags for rare ammo packs** (Prapor takes USEC tags, Peacekeeper takes BEAR tags; 2 barters each at LL2/LL3, 8 in total).
reward_exp_boost: Gameplay EXP x2: kills, taking damage, healing, leveling up and other EXP sources are all doubled.
reward_skill_boost: Skill growth accelerated (skill progress x3, points needed per level divided by 3).
reward_trader_sale: All traders' prices are 50% off + restocking is faster.
rising_tensions: Official "Rising Tensions" (2024-12-23): **Prapor's and Peacekeeper's underbarrel grenade launchers and their ammo are 25% off**.
sanitar_event: Official "Sanitar Event" (2022-11-11): **Sanitar appears on Customs with 4~5 guards and a 100% spawn chance**.
santa_2022: Official Christmas Event 2022 (from 12/25): **the hideout Christmas tree returns**, **Santa Claus hands out loot across all maps** (carrying Santa's Bag), **Bosses and their guards wear Santa hats**. Note this entry is equivalent to the "Christmas" seasonal window; only the gift packages are the 2022 version.
scav_gang_conflict: Official "Scav Gang Conflict" (2024-12-20): **Ragman (LL3) trades armor plates for melee weapons (1:1, 4 barters in total)**.
scav_on_labs: Official "Scav On Labs Event" (2022-12-04): **Glukhar appears in The Lab with 6 guards at 100%**; **Glukhar is temporarily removed from Reserve**; **player SCAVs can enter The Lab**.
scav_takeover: Official "Scav Takeover" (2023-05-20): Fence's people block every route - **only one map is free to enter**, other maps require **items** as a toll; **players below level 16 are unaffected**; **the free map rotates daily**, nine maps in total (including The Lab).
scourge_incursion: Official "Scourge Incursion" (2026-10-16 to 10-20): **Ref's arena champion team breaks into The Lab**, led by a figure codenamed "Scourge". During the event **The Lab spawns this squad at 100%** (1 leader + 4 escorts); **6 quest lines** are unlocked at the same time (5 from Therapist + 1 from Mechanic).
shifting_balance: Official "Shifting Balance" (2026-09-08): **Glukhar moves from Reserve to the Lighthouse water treatment plant** and spawns at 100% in every raid with a fixed **3 guards (one of each kind)**; **Reserve no longer spawns him**.
smugglers_2024: Official "Smugglers 2024" (2024-12-06): **the new enemy type "Smugglers" appears in groups of 3 at 100% on all maps except Ground Zero** (including Lighthouse/Streets of Tarkov/Reserve).
smugglers_2026: Official "Smugglers 2026" (2026-03-12): **Smugglers in groups of 3~4 return to Customs, Woods, Shoreline, Interchange, Lighthouse, Streets of Tarkov and Ground Zero**; **sealed weapon cases and locked crates appear in airdrops**; **Reserve spawns all SCAV Bosses in every raid**. Note **the level 21 requirement applies only to Ground Zero** (the other 6 maps are unrestricted).
softcore: Official "Softcore" (2025-10-08): **free entry to The Lab**; **overweight threshold +50%**; **flea market lowered to level 10**; **global loot chance +15%**; **more containers/travel bags/stashes**; **Therapist (LL2) dogtag barters**; **higher spawn rate for colored Lab keycards**; **recoil inertia and aim punch reduced**. Note container counts and marked rooms are approximations.
stim_event: Official stim event (2022-12-21): **all of Obdolbos' positive buffs are raised to +20**; **11 stims have their negative debuffs removed** (SJ1/SJ6/Propital/Zagustin/Adrenaline/3-(b-TG)/AHF1-M/L1/M.U.L.E./Meldonin/P22).
supply_and_demand: Official "Supply and Demand" (2024-08-02): **Mechanic's prices go up (x1.15)**; an event quest is unlocked.
targrad_tales: Official "Targrad Tales" (2025-08-20): **14 event quests** (the Friend from Norvinsk series, Game Review 1~3, Progression Difficulties 1~2, etc.); the **level-3 rest area in the hideout also gets a disc slot** for playing a text RPG.
tarkov_hospitality: Official "Tarkov Hospitality" (2026-06-05): **Ref's cleanup crew spawns in every raid on Customs/Shoreline/Woods** (neutral to PMCs); **Reshala / Sanitar / Shturman spawn in every raid on their own maps**; Sanitar can also spawn at the Smuggler base on Shoreline; **Knight / Big Pipe / Birdeye do not spawn at all in PvE mode**.
tarkov_mystery: Official "The Tarkov Mystery" (2024-05-15): **Shoreline spawns a Peacekeeper squad at 100% and Customs spawns a Prapor squad at 100%** (they fight each other and you too); **airdrop crates additionally contain 1~2 "encrypted flash drives"** (official random contents still appear); 1 event quest is unlocked.
terragroup_trail: Official "The TerraGroup Trail" (2023-07-28): **The Goons leave the other maps and go to Shoreline to guard Sanitar**.
thermal_for_treats: Official "Thermal Scopes for Treats" (2024-12-24): **Mechanic barters thermal scopes at LL1 for chocolate or liquor** (8 recipes: Shakhin 3.7x / FLIR RS-32 / Zeus-Pro 640 / ECHO1, etc.); Mechanic's whole shop is 20% off.
tourists_2023: Official June 2023 window event: **the eastern trio Knight / Big Pipe / Birdeye moves into Factory**, with the matching quest "Tourists". The trio spawns on Factory both day and night, and the quest is simply to kill them.
unlocked_2023_08: Official "Unlocked Traders & Discounts" (2023-08 run): **all traders unlocked to Loyalty 4** (regardless of progress), **all goods at 50% off**, **purchase limits removed**.
unlocked_traders: Official "Unlocked Traders & Discounts": **all traders unlocked to Loyalty 4** (regardless of progress), **all goods at 50% off**, **purchase limits removed**.
untar_reconnaissance: Official "UNTAR Reconnaissance" (2023-08-07): **Reshala / Killa / Tagilla / Glukhar / Shturman at 100% on their own home maps**; **Killa and Glukhar are pulled out of Streets of Tarkov**; **Cultists at 100% everywhere they appear, except 50% on Shoreline**; **Bloodhounds reduced to 20% on three maps**.
weapon_case_airdrops: Official "Weapon Case Airdrops" (2023-06-19): **sealed weapon cases appear inside airdrop crates** (added on top of the official random contents, rather than replacing the whole crate). Note the "locked crates" mentioned in the same official sentence share a name with sealed weapon cases in local data and cannot be told apart, so they were not added separately.
wild_wild_woods: Official "Wild Wild Woods" (06-25~07-01): Woods SCAVs mutiny and move loot to the reserve. **Shturman shows up every raid and always carries a silver badge**, high-value loot spikes (spawn points x1.6, loot chance x2, containers x1.5; moonshine/colored keycards/keys mixed in), PMCs are suppressed; 4 event quests unlock (Fence: hand in 12 silver badges, kill 18 SCAVs, 2 fetch quests for set types).
